result.summary: The page is largely intact; most edge clipping is from expected horizontal carousels or bottom viewport overflow and was excluded. One suspicious content artifact remains: a promo badge showing “-100%”.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card shows a promo badge labeled “-100%”, which is ambiguous/nonsensical as a discount value and may indicate incorrect promo formatting or data.
issues.suggestion: Verify the promotion value/format and render a clear label such as “100% off”, “Free delivery”, or the correct percentage/amount instead of “-100%”.
